text.text_excerpt: This place was just fantastic! I would highly recommend if you're a visitor to the City or a local looking for a cool, new place to dine with your friends. Wonderful environment and the delicious menu items were the icing on the cake! My sister and brother in law introduced me to this place and it was just impressive from beginning to end. Only thing that was a distraction was that the place is LOUD. So , don't expect to have a quiet conversation here. We had reservations on a Friday evening but were seated pretty quickly. The place was packed and it looked like a mix of tourists and some Happy Hour folks. It's a gorgeous, modern space. And by no means was it formal. The servers were all ...

What an amazing meal! This place is popular (read: packed) and I can see why. Definitely get a reservation, they were turning people away left and right. We ordered raw oysters to start. There were several option, we asked the server's opinion. Outstanding, fresh, plump. I'd never had them with just red wine vinegar, I really liked it. We also got the fried bread balls. So good, better than they should be, highly recommended. We decided to share the whole redfish as our entree and got brussel sprouts and rice as sides. Thanks to everyone on Yelp that encouraged the whole redfish, it was one of the best things I've ever had. The sprouts were awesome, the crispy rice also good. All in all, ...

I don't like throwing around terms like "life-changing" that often, but... Peche was pretty a damn life-changing meal. Me made a reservation for lunch weeks in advance (which was a good thing because the place filled up pretty quickly). Our table was towards the back corner, next to some huge windows and the back door, perfect for people watching. The natural sunlight also made for some amazing Instagram shots. Our server Chris was a delight. He was spot on with his recommendations, and he was a saint for putting up with our rambunctiousness.
